title: India just had its best year ever for wind power
sources: IANS Live - India adds highest-ever 6.05 GW wind energy in FY26, 46 pc jump from FY25
Swarajya Mag - India Adds Record 6.1 GW Wind Capacity in FY26
caption:
India just had its best year ever for wind power. A record that stood for nearly a decade just fell.

India added 6.05-6.1 GW of wind capacity in FY26, a 46% jump over FY25 and the highest-ever annual addition on record - beating the previous 5.5 GW record set in FY17. Total installed wind capacity now stands at 59.2 GW. The government targets 100 GW by 2030 and officials expect FY27 to beat this year's record too.

A record that held for nine years just got broken by 46%. And officials say next year's record is already expected to beat this one.

Sources: IANS, Swarajya Mag (2026)
